_note: Illustrative handoff file for the dental-clinic example. Matches examples/scoring-model.json. Format: references/handoff-format.md.

offer.in_scope: Booking software for private dental clinics, about USD 4,800 a year

candidate_offers.name: One booking diary across all your branches
A free check of how many booking calls go unanswered

icp_sentence: Private dental clinics in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt that are losing bookings to unanswered phone calls, with 10 to 50 staff and a dedicated practice manager

tiers.description: Private dental clinics, 10 to 50 staff, with a practice manager, in the three cities

filters.why_it_matters: The offer is dental booking software
filters.evidence: All 4 won calls are dental clinics (illustrative)

filters.why_it_matters: The client serves only these cities
filters.evidence: Blocking question 3: the client serves these three cities only (illustrative)

filters.why_it_matters: Enough bookings to lose, too small for a call centre
Someone owns the diary and the missed calls
Already used to booking online, so the switch is small
One diary across branches is the value only the client gives
filters.evidence: Why they buy: T1 and T3 (illustrative)

tiers.description: The same clinics with 51 to 100 staff
tiers.direction_evidence: One won call at 60 staff shows the same pain (illustrative)

filters.why_it_matters: Same missed-call pain at higher volume

disqualifiers.rule: outside Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt
disqualifiers.evidence: Blocking question 3: the client serves these three cities only (illustrative)

signals.name: 2+ reviews in 90 days say calls or bookings go unanswered
signals.why_now: Patients are being lost this month
signals.reliability_reason: dated, public, and seen before 3 of 4 wins
signals.link_to_pain: Step 4 heuristic for the top pain (unanswered calls, 3 of 4 wins) (illustrative)

signals.name: Hiring front-desk staff
signals.why_now: The front desk is overstretched now
signals.reliability_reason: dated, but hiring can mean normal turnover
signals.link_to_pain: Look-back: front-desk job post before 3 of 4 wins, 0 of 2 losses (illustrative)

signals.name: Opened a new branch
signals.where: Company website, Google Business listings, local press
signals.why_now: A second diary has just appeared
signals.reliability_reason: dated, public, and seen before 2 of 4 wins
signals.link_to_pain: Look-back: new branch before 2 of 4 wins, 0 of 2 losses (illustrative)

tier2_start_rule: Once every Tier 1 account has been contacted at least once, add as much of Tier 2 as the client can work this quarter.
assumptions: Offer B's value has no customer proof yet
open_questions: Is the price per clinic or per group?
